body: The ferry horn blared again, this time sounding only twice. I felt a familiar sense of protectiveness wash over me, knowing instinctively how to respond. My legs moved without conscious thought, heading towards the edge of the crowd where someone was obviously struggling. I reached out my hand, hoping it would be strong enough to help. As they clung to my arm for dear life, I took a deep breath, ready to guide them to safety if needed.
